summary: Eldorado Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K on June 24, 2026, reporting voting results from its Annual Shareholders Meeting held on June 23, 2026. The filing discloses the election of directors (all management nominees received 80%+ support), appointment of KPMG LLP as auditors (98.55% for), authorization to fix auditor remuneration, and advisory approval of executive compensation. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activism, tender offer, or restructuring—is present. This is a routine periodic report of shareholder meeting outcomes, not a triggering corporate action requiring special-situation classification.
